title: Keep agent metadata out of bounded code-state discovery
problem: The daemon's bounded file discovery can spend its initial scan on local agent/editor metadata directories, producing event churn and delaying authoritative source files needed for impact routing.

acceptanceCriteria.condition: Known local agent/editor metadata directories are excluded at every depth without excluding ordinary source directories.
A source file remains discoverable within the bounded initial/reconciliation scan when metadata directories contain many files.
Ignored metadata and unchanged source do not create synthetic CodeGraphUpdated churn.
Windows Node 24, Ubuntu Node 22/24, and macOS Node 24 pass the code-state lifecycle and full CI matrix.

evidencePlan.coordination: Record a pre-change Intent, routed code entities, stable N-1 mutation receipt, and final WorkItem handoff before runtime cleanup.
evidencePlan.correctness: Bind the exact source/test commit and GitHub check-run conclusions to this task.
evidencePlan.performance: Record bounded scan/event counts and whether metadata starvation was removed.
